I replied to Ilse in her DM (DV03OPU0001) and confirmed I'll keep the possible move to Bay 35 between us. I won't mention it in any channel, file or other conversation.

My first reply went too far: it offered to post the news wherever she liked once it was confirmed. The rules say I can't move something from a DM into a channel, even if she asks, unless everyone there could already see it. So I sent a short correction. Once the change is official, she or the depot owner should announce it, and I can point people to that announcement.

I didn't look anything up and didn't search or post anywhere else, because she wasn't asking a question.
